_doc: Per-asset overrides for npm run assets:build. Keys are file names in assets/source/. "triangles": 0 disables decimation. "nocolMaxSpan": metres — loose parts narrower than this across their second-widest axis (ropes, pegs, hardware) are split into a "*_nocol" object and stop colliding; 0 disables. "collisionProxy": adds a low-poly "*_col" mesh the game collides with instead of the visual geometry — "dissolve" merges near-flat faces and keeps every opening (use this for anything you walk into), "hull" replaces each shell with its convex hull (cheaper, but seals doorways — for props you walk around), "" disables. "collisionProxyAngle": degrees, how flat two faces must be to merge. Images in assets/source/pictures/ become picture slabs instead: they take "pictureDefaults" plus a same-filename override, and only "height" is authored — width follows the image aspect.
